guidance: Capture decisions and owners, not a transcript. Keep notes terse. Every action item must be concrete and owned. Prefer bullets. Do not invent decisions that were not made—write "None" when empty.

outline.title: Context
outline.guidance: Frame the meeting goal and attendees.

children.title: Objective
children.guidance: The single goal of this meeting in one or two sentences.

outline.title: Discussion Topics
outline.guidance: Group topics covered in the meeting.

children.title: Topic
children.guidance: Title each instance with the topic name, not "Topic".

children.title: Key Notes
children.guidance: Important context or updates for this topic. Bullets preferred.

children.title: Decisions Made
children.guidance: Finalized agreements for this topic, or "None".

outline.title: Action Items
outline.guidance: Owned next steps from the meeting.

children.title: Task
children.guidance: Title each instance with the action verb phrase, not "Task".

children.title: Next Steps
children.guidance: What specifically needs to happen next.
